mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nw_webhook_create_receipts (tenant_id, request_id, actor_ref) VALUES (#{tenant}, CAST(#{request} AS uuid), #{actor}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, request_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE nw_webhook_create_receipts SET subscription_id = #{subscription} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenant} AND request_id = CAST(#{request} AS uuid) AND subscription_id IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT actor_ref, subscription_id FROM nw_webhook_create_receipts WHERE tenant_id = #{tenant} AND request_id = CAST(#{request} AS uuid)
